title: Edmund and the Spire Again
author: Noor Thackeray
blurb: Lior Dravenmoor, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
